spanish: Y tomará desde sangre del toro, y rociará en su dedo sobre faces de la kappóret kedmah; y delante de la kappóret rociará siete veces desde la sangre en su dedo.

findings.issue: Common noun הַכַּפֹּרֶת (H3727, feminine singular with article) is left as the transliteration kappóret instead of Spanish.
Common noun קֵדְמָה (H6924, masculine singular with suffix Sd) is left as the transliteration kedmah instead of Spanish.

notes: The rest of the clause matches the tokens in person, number, stems, articles, and order.
